question: What realization grants the speaker the power to create, remove, or transform all reality?
premises: By a certain power the speaker becomes capable.
This capability includes doing, removing, and transforming.
The scope of this capability is all this.
inference: The realized power enables the speaker to create, withdraw, and transform the entirety of reality.
plain_english: Ah, by which I am capable of creating, removing, or otherwise transforming all this!
